summary: Looks up string a2 in the owner's string table via BinarySearchInStringTable. On a successful lookup, copies a2 into the this+0xC buffer (or clears the buffer to an empty string when a2 is null). Returns the destination buffer pointer in all paths.

operations.description: Take the destination buffer pointer as this+0xC.
Call BinarySearchInStringTable with the owner, the source string a2, and the destination buffer to validate a2 against the string table.
Proceed only when BinarySearchInStringTable returns non-zero (string found); otherwise leave the buffer untouched.
When the source string a2 is non-null, copy it into the destination buffer; when a2 is null, write a terminating zero to clear the buffer.
Copy a2 into the this+0xC buffer with strcpy (non-null a2 path), or store an empty string at the buffer start (null a2 path).
Return the destination buffer pointer regardless of lookup outcome.

unresolved: Semantics of the string table and which caller strings are expected to pass validation are not derivable from this function alone.
